item.title: Life partner of young mother who was found dismembered in garbage bag speaks out
item.description: Michelle Montgomery's life partner and father of her youngest child, who is only 10 months old, is speaking out after her body was found dismembered in a garbage bag in Brooklyn.

item.title: FDA recall: Erectile dysfunction drug found in honey energy supplement
item.description: The FDA issued a recall Wednesday for a honey energy supplement after an undeclared erectile dysfunction medication was found in the product.

item.title: 'The Muppet Show' returns for new adventures, featuring Sabrina Carpenter
item.description: If you watched "The Muppets" in decades past, you'd see such stars as Rita Moreno, Elton John and Liza Minnelli. Now, 50 year later, it's time to play the music and it's time to light the lights again!

item.title: Olivia Colman and John Lithgow star 'Jimpa,' new queer family drama
item.description: Three generations, one city and a whole lot of heart. Stars Olivia Colman and John Lithgow tell "important message" behind their new film, "Jimpa."

item.title: Paterson community outraged after school board reveals plans to close 4 schools
item.description: A community is outraged after a school board revealed a plan to close four public schools in Paterson.

item.title: Kathryn Garcia expected to be confirmed as Port Authority's new executive director
item.description: More than a decade of power struggles over the Port Authority is set to end Thursday when Kathryn Garcia is confirmed as the agency's new executive director.

item.title: 25 percent of students absent from LI school district due to reported ICE activity
item.description: The Greenport School District in Suffolk County said 25 percent of its students were absent from school on Wednesday after reports of ICE activity in the community.

item.title: Nonprofit group in Montclair seeking help after burst pipe floods building
item.description: A local charity group, focused on helping many people in their community, now needs help itself after a burst pipe flooded out its place of operation in Montclair, New Jersey.

item.title: Fundraiser held for New Jersey high school wrestler severely injured during match
item.description: The match between Old Bridge High School and South Plainfield High School Wednesday night, served was a fundraiser for 16-year-old Adriana Maria.

item.title: Supreme Court allows new California congressional districts that favor Democrats
item.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday allowed California to use a new voter-approved congressional map that is favorable to Democrats in this year's elections, rejecting a last-ditch plea from state Republicans and the Trump administration.
